mockInterview.entrySubtitle: Practice a spoken interview tailored to this role, then get private coaching.
mockInterview.disclaimer: Practice only. Your answers stay private and are never shared with the employer.
mockInterview.setupSubtitle: Pick the CV you'll interview with and choose how you'd like to answer.
mockInterview.cvPickerSubtitle: Questions are tailored to how this CV fits the role.
mockInterview.cvNoneBody: Finish a CV first so the interviewer can tailor questions to your experience.
mockInterview.lowSignalNote: We have limited data on your CVs, so these are best-effort matches.
mockInterview.modeTitle: How would you like to answer?
mockInterview.modeVoiceHint: Speak your answers; the interviewer speaks back.
mockInterview.micPromptNotice: We'll ask for microphone access when you start.
mockInterview.micDeniedNotice: We couldn't reach your microphone, so we've switched to text. You can still practice by typing.
mockInterview.micUnsupportedNotice: This browser doesn't support voice practice. You can practice by typing instead.
mockInterview.prepLoadError: We couldn't load your CVs. Please try again.
mockInterview.blockQuotaDailyBody: You can run more voice interviews tomorrow. Practicing by text is still available.
mockInterview.blockQuotaWeeklyTitle: You've reached this week's practice limit
mockInterview.blockQuotaWeeklyBody: Your allowance refreshes on Monday. Practicing by text is still available.
mockInterview.blockActiveTitle: You have an interview in progress
mockInterview.blockActiveBody: Finish or discard it before starting a new one.
mockInterview.blockNoCvBody: You need at least one ready CV before you can practice.
mockInterview.blockGenericBody: Please try again in a moment.
mockInterview.orbAria: The interviewer is present and listening.
mockInterview.textModeNotice: Voice isn't available, so you're practicing by text.
mockInterview.turnError: Something interrupted the interviewer. Try answering again.
mockInterview.reportSubtitle: Notes to help you prepare — no scores, just guidance.
mockInterview.fallbackNote: The AI coach is offline, so these are general pointers for this kind of role.
mockInterview.noReportBody: This session ended before coaching could be generated.
mockInterview.transcriptSubtitle: The full conversation from this session.
mockInterview.shareToggleLabel: Share this transcript to help improve the AI
mockInterview.shareToggleHint: Optional. Personal details are removed before any review.
mockInterview.shareError: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
mockInterview.deleteConfirmBody: The transcript and coaching will be permanently removed. This can't be undone.
mockInterview.deleteError: We couldn't delete this session. Please try again.
mockInterview.historyEmptyBody: Run your first mock interview to see it here.
mockInterview.historyError: We couldn't load your past sessions.
mockInterview.myInterviewsSubtitle: Review coaching and transcripts from your past practice sessions.
mockInterview.myInterviewsEmptyTitle: You haven't practiced any interviews yet
mockInterview.myInterviewsEmptyBody: Open a job you're interested in and start a mock interview — it'll show up here.
mockInterview.myInterviewsDetailError: We couldn't load this session. Please try again.
mockInterview.screenErrorBody: We couldn't run the mock interview. Please try again.
